scope: per-turn content-addressed store, default off; three pre-registered gates; 0 training, 0 optimizer steps, 0 Adam, 0 confirm, 0 new parameters

structural.error_direction_definition: per correction surface: tuple of (position, gold byte, predicted byte) for every position where the constrained answer differs from gold; two turns share a direction only when the tuples are identical

information.primary_metric: leave-one-out decision-bit accuracy: correct decision bytes at positions [7, 8] divided by 2 bits x 22 turns
information.strongest_control: max(permutation per-seed max, random same-norm, no-F state)
information.decision_rule: all three gates pass -> option2_passed; any fail -> option2_failed

script.note: report written before formatting; submitted bytes are recorded afterwards
script.post_format_note: black reported one reformatted file (the probe script); the pre-commit ruff hook then removed one unused import and one redundant encode argument (both behaviour-neutral), so the submitted bytes are recorded after both steps; no measured value changed between the run-time bytes and the submitted bytes

mechanism.key: mean of BytePatchEncoder.context over the turn query bytes (128-d)
mechanism.value: the turn's post-read F copy, shape (4,2,32,32)
mechanism.blend: F <- (1-alpha)F + alpha * sum p_i V_i, alpha 0.5
mechanism.scope: session-only; cleared at the first turn of a new session

failure_localization.structural_fact: 22 distinct F vectors on the 22 surfaces; window released_lines=5: F=5 vs error directions=3; window released_lines=10: F=17 vs error directions=7
failure_localization.stop_rule: stopped on the failed gates only; no threshold change, no criterion change, no alternative option selected, no pricing, no 20.4, no training proposal

retrieval.real_eviction_note: sessions are cleared before 32 slots fill, so the real run never evicts; the FIFO branch is exercised by the synthetic probe
retrieval.self_key_note: self cosine is read on the final state; sessions 1-2 slots are zeroed at each session boundary and no correction surface exists in session 3, so 0.0 here is the clearing artifact, not a retrieval miss; the read-time margins below are the hit diagnostic

key_separation.note: the 22 query keys are nearly collinear, so a temperature of 0.1 still gives a flat softmax and the read is close to an average of all live slots

store_off_parity.digest_note: state_digest covers the journal, whose model_version field is the arm name; CF1 and B_EH therefore differ by construction, this predates 20.3a

decode_rules.decode: greedy argmax over the 256 byte ids on the fixed 15-byte contract
decode_rules.feedback_release: atomic five-line batches; only released lines enter E and F
decode_rules.fast_write: CF1 writes F from released feedback only; B_EH never writes F
decode_rules.fast_window: F edits happen inside the release call; query and self-generated bytes cannot write
decode_rules.session_freeze: every parameter frozen inside a session; F state is the only inference-plastic tensor
decode_rules.truth_isolation: rule id, signature, truth table and solver are scoring-only
decode_rules.answer_contract: 应送(左|右)箱。; decision bytes at positions 7..8
decode_rules.store_write: addressed_store_enabled only: value = the turn's post-read F copy, written at every turn and at every released line; default off
decode_rules.store_read: cosine similarity between the 128-d mean of BytePatchEncoder.context(query) and the stored keys; softmax temperature 0.1; F <- (1-a)F + a*sum p_i V_i, a=0.5
decode_rules.addressed_write: addressed store writes are structural, never gradient driven
decode_rules.fifo: 32 slots, eviction of the lowest insertion age when full
decode_rules.cross_session_clear: the store is zeroed at the first turn of a new session and is never restored across a session boundary

boundary_of_the_claim: failed gate facts only; no alternative option is selected here
